text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup. Kitasan Black is joining
this
massive carnival while shouldering
the whole of
Japan like it's an enormous
portable shrine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Past winners come up to Kitasan Black to
give her
pointers on how to handle the
pressure of the
race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Kitasan. You have to keep your
guard up.
Otherwise, the speed demons
of the world will
sprint off and leave you
in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Vodka! I'll stick right to my
opponents, no
matter how hard they try
to shake me off!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Since people call me the Ruler of Japan,
and
you're known as the clutch captain, I
hope you'll
do your best as Japan's
clutchest captain!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will! It's an honor to be regarded as
your equal!
I'll do my best to carry out
my given role!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Kita. You have to win this,
just like
I did because of how much I
admired Prez.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I want to be like you too! I
might not
be able to run in as cool a
manner as you, but I'll
do it in my own
way.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... There's so much riding on my

shoulders... I knew that going in, but
still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I mean, I can't embarrass myself
in front of
the whole world, and I've got
to shoulder this
weight all the way to the
finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black has made it through some
tight
spots before, but it seems bearing
her country's
banner is weighing heavily
on her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-sure! Sounds good. We can't just stand
around
like this. To the paddock!
choice_data_list: Anyway, shall we head to the paddock?
Anyway, let's head to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But despite her apprehension, I know
she'll be
fine, no matter how heavy the
burden she carries
is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Go, Kitasan! We're right here with you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Your cheering squad, reporting for duty!
Today,
we fight together!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kiiitasan! KIIITASAN!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Trainer... look...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cheers keep coming. That's right. A
great
deal of people saw her run at the
autumn Tenno
Sho.
choice_data_list: Everyone else will help carry the mikoshi, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her performance there dazzled many
into
becoming fans, and now, they've
surged forward
to help shoulder the
weight of representing
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right. The very people I want to
make smile
are here for me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oooh yeah! I've got to be front and
center to
hype up the crowd! This
festival belongs to us!
